text: Don't waste time on resources you won't finish. One qbank done well beats three started.
source: IMG who failed then passed on retry

text: I scored 46% on my first NBME. I passed the real exam. Trust the process.
Start UWorld on day one. I waited three months and regretted every day of it.
Rest when you need to. This is a marathon, not a sprint. Keep positive energy.
Doing First Aid alone is a mistake. You need to solve questions from the beginning.
I worked 40 hours a week and still passed. Consistency beats intensity.
NBME concepts covered 50-60% of my real exam. Take them seriously.
Every champion was once a contender who refused to give up.
My first UWorld pass was 40%. Second pass was 60%. I passed Step 1.
Don't be scared to reschedule. Better to delay and pass than rush and fail.
Keep resources simple. FA and UWorld over extras. Every time.
The exam felt easier than my NBMEs. Trust your preparation.
